title: Voices in a Crowd: Searching for Clusters of Unique Perspectives

bias_targets.methodology: Generating behavioral embeddings based on individual annotators' predictions on media and climate datasets, clustering these embeddings using unsupervised methods (like K-means and UMAP), and measuring the clusters' purity against self-reported political leaning metadata (e.g., Left, Right, Center) to identify distinct ideological perspectives.

Evaluating the external validity and purity of annotator behavior clusters against self-reported education level metadata to identify distinct socioeconomic and intersectional minority voices (e.g., highly educated vs. non-highly educated).
